bios.one_line: CMO and brand strategist with 20+ years building and scaling B2B, fintech, and financial brands.
bios.short_50_word: Adrian M. Peticila is a CMO and brand strategist with 20+ years across B2B software, fintech, and financial services. Founder of Aah, Monster!, an executive personal branding consultancy. Known for turning complex positioning into sharp, defensible market authority.
bios.official_100_word: Adrian M. Peticila is a Chief Marketing Officer and brand strategist with over two decades of experience building, repositioning, and scaling B2B technology, fintech, and financial services brands. Having led marketing functions across three distinct CMO tracks (greenfield build, turnaround, and international expansion), he advises founders and C-suite leaders on positioning, go-to-market strategy, and executive authority. He is the founder of Aah, Monster!, a no-bullshit personal branding consultancy, and writes on marketing strategy, positioning, and AI workflows.
bios.speaker: Adrian M. Peticila is a veteran CMO, brand strategist, and founder of Aah, Monster! With 20+ years steering B2B, fintech, and software brands across five continents, Adrian speaks on positioning without fluff, executive authority in the AI era, and building marketing architectures that actually close revenue.
bios.press: Adrian M. Peticila is a Romanian marketing executive, CMO, and brand strategist based in Bucharest. With a 20+ year track record spanning financial services, B2B SaaS, and fintech turnaround, he is the founder of personal branding advisory Aah, Monster! and author of executive guides on positioning.
